events.evidence: President Sebastián Piñera announces the cancellation of the 2019 APEC Summit and the United Nations Climate Change Conference
The first meeting of the Syrian Constitutional Committee takes place in Geneva in a bid to end the country's eight-year-long civil war
Twitter announces it will ban all political ads on its platform starting November 22

label.note: Social unrest cancels APEC, offset by Syria talks; Twitter ad ban minor.
